_om: Vri åtter in English (Crazy Eights, rusj.no/en/crazy-eights/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Mobilen legger det som passer, helt tilf: The phone plays whatever fits, completely at random. Good for little ones.
Mobilen sparer på åtterne og spiller far: The phone saves its eights and plays the suit it has most of.
Mobilen teller kort, husker hva dere man: The phone counts cards, remembers what you're missing and blocks you. Can you beat it?
Whoever wins three rounds first wins.
Vinneren av runden får poeng for kortene: The round's winner scores points for the cards the others are left holding. First to 100 wins.
Én runde – den som først blir kvitt kort: One round – whoever gets rid of their cards first wins.
{hvem} fikk ikke trukket – bunken er tom: {hvem} couldn't draw – the pile is empty.
You have to draw {antall} and miss a go.
{hvem} has to draw {antall} and misses a go.
The cards have been shuffled into a new pile.
Fortsatt ingenting å legge. Trekk igjen: Still nothing to play. Draw again ({n} of 3).
You've nothing to play. Draw a card.
Ingenting passet etter tre kort. Du må s: Nothing fitted after three cards. You have to pass.
Ingenting å legge, og bunken er tom. Du: Nothing to play, and the pile is empty. You have to pass.
On top is the {kort}. The suit is {farge}.
Nobody could go on – fewest cards wins.
Du ble kvitt alle kortene!: You got rid of all your cards!
{navn} got rid of their cards first.
{navn} ble kvitt alle kortene!: {navn} got rid of all their cards!
Bli kvitt alle kortene dine først. Alle: Be the first to get rid of all your cards. Everyone gets five cards (seven if there are two of you), and one card is turned face up on the table. This is Crazy Eights the Scandinavian way: if you can't go, you draw up to three cards, then pass.
Legg et kort i samme farge (hjerter, rut: Play a card of the same suit (hearts, diamonds, spades or clubs) or the same number or picture as the top card. Tap the card – or drag it to the table.
En åtter kan legges på hva som helst. Da: An eight can go on anything. Then you choose the suit the next player has to follow.
Har du ingenting å legge, trekker du ett: If you've nothing to play, draw one card at a time – up to three. If nothing fits then either, you pass.
Den som først blir kvitt alle kortene si: The first to get rid of all their cards wins the round.
Først til 3: Den som først vinner tre ru: First to 3: whoever wins three rounds first wins the match.
100 poeng: Vinneren av runden får poeng: 100 points: the round's winner scores points for the cards the others have left – eights 50, picture cards 10, aces 1 and the rest the number they show. First to 100 wins.
Spar på åtterne! De redder deg når ingen: Save your eights! They rescue you when nothing else fits.
Snus en åtter først, stokkes den inn igj: If the first card turned up is an eight, it's shuffled back in and a new card is turned up.
Er bunken tom, stokkes kortene på bordet: If the pile runs out, the cards on the table (except the top one) are shuffled into a new pile.
Husregel «Toer»: Legger noen en toer, må: House rule ‘Twos’: if someone plays a two, the next player has to draw two cards and misses a go. It's off by default.
Flere på én mobil: Kortene skjules mello: Several on one phone: the cards are hidden between turns. Tap ‘Show my cards’ once you've got the phone.
Hvordan vil dere spille?: How do you want to play?
Kortene skjules mellom hver tur, så inge: The cards are hidden between turns, so nobody sees anyone else's.
Legger noen en toer, må den neste trekke: If someone plays a two, the next player has to draw two cards and misses a go.
Godt kjempa! Neste gang er åtterne på di: Well fought! Next time the eights will be on your side.
Du har et kort som passer – legg det: You've got a card that fits – play it
Jeg slo mobilen i Vri åtter ({niva}), {s: I beat the phone at Crazy Eights ({niva}), {stilling}. Can you do better?
Mobilen slo meg i Vri åtter ({niva}), {s: The phone beat me at Crazy Eights ({niva}), {stilling}. Can you do better?
{navn} vant Vri åtter ({stilling})! Ta e: {navn} won Crazy Eights ({stilling})! Have a go yourself.
Dere går til kåringen. Runden dere er mi: You'll go to the results. The round you're in the middle of doesn't count.
You can always start a new one.
